This supports dysphagia and slowed, effortful speech; the wording 'as evidenced by' is interpretive but consistent with the transcript.
When asked about facial asymmetry, patient denies noticing any: 'Have you noticed any kind of, um, asymmetry in your face...?' Patient: 'Mmm, no, not really.'

Doctor asks about discoloration and coldness: 'is there any discoloration in your hand?' Patient: 'no.' and 'does your hand feel cold?' Patient: 'the arm feels fine, apart from me not being able to move it.' This supports denial of discoloration or coldness.
